citation.source: 7 CFR 210.10 — the five reimbursable-meal food components are fruits, vegetables, grains, meats/meat alternates, and fluid milk; seasonings are not among them (addressed only via the meal pattern's separate sodium limits, not credited toward any food-group requirement).
citation.note: Same five-component structure directly confirmed against the regulation text (law.cornell.edu's eCFR mirror, 2026-08-19) used for oil.json/butter.json.
